Subject: Your warranty claim BW-3350

Hi Olivia,

A blender that is used every morning should last far longer than 11 months. Yours is covered, and we will repair or replace it at no cost.

I have attached a prepaid label. Please post the blender within 14 days, with a copy of your proof of purchase in the box. A receipt or an order email is fine.

Repairs take about a week once it reaches the workshop. I will write again when it is on its way back.

Greg, Brightwell
